name: UI：环节参数详情-取消不持久化+重开状态一致验证
description: 验证取消按钮关闭弹窗后不持久化任何修改，重新打开弹窗状态与初始一致

steps.expression: (() => { const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')); const el = spans.find(s => (s.textContent || '').trim() === '入参'); if (!el) return { found: false }; const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: rect.x + rect.width/2, y: rect.y + rect.height/2 }; })()

steps.description: 打开环节参数详情弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); const initialState = wrappers.map(w => ({ label: (w.textContent || '').trim(), checked: w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked })); const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const inputValues = inputs.map(inp => ({ value: (inp.value || '').substring(0, 80) })).slice(0, 10); return { open: true, checkedCount: initialState.filter(c => c.checked).length, totalCheckboxes: initialState.length, checkboxes: initialState, inputValues, snapshot: JSON.stringify(initialState) }; })()
steps.description: 记录初始状态(checkbox+输入值)作为基准快照

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 修改checkbox状态后点取消关闭弹窗；重新打开同一弹窗状态应恢复为初始值；通过snapshot字符串比对确保完全一致
riskPoints: 取消后是否有确认弹层(二次确认)
后端是否在取消时也静默保存(不应发生)
重新打开时是否从后端重新拉取数据(确保不是前端缓存)
_testDesign.safetyNote: 仅使用取消按钮，不点保存，不影响生产数据
